page.layout: One block: a vellum-bound spine or cover, with handwritten ink at the top, a stain in the middle, and a printed library shelf label at the foot.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The top is manuscript ink on the vellum, reading "Th. Beza Homil. in hist. passionis et sepult. I.C" with "1592" below it. This is handwriting, not print, so it is not transcribed. The label "Bd 439" at the foot is a library shelf mark and is excluded. The brown marks in the middle are a stain.
